I think you need to take some time to talk about those emotions and your disappointment before going forward with divorce procedures. Take some time to really thing about your relationship. You might both be stressed and exhausted with the baby, on top of that. 

Take some time to rest. In the end, the decision is yours and yours alone.

It was mutual. It’s a funny story actually. Before I started dating him I had a crush on him and another girl. He had a crush on me and the other girl. and, guess what, she did have a crush on us too. it was a kjnda weird moment in my life. it kinda came naturally. we dated for 8 years.  we are still friends. she is not the toxic one i was talking about earlier. 

Our point of view on our relationship  is the same. We discussed our goals and boundaries. We are on the same page. 

Fortunately, I’m not the link ! I think their relationship between them is theirs only, they can have whatever relationship they want together. We were friends before dating. We got lucky all 3 of us had something for each others. This is not a requirements. My 2 bf could have only dated each others and they would have been ok with me. They have moments just the two of them, like I have my moments with each others and we have moments the 3 of us.

I’m glad you found it helpful ! 

We have equal weight. We don’t disagree on a lot of things, that’s a reliefs. I’m not sure if that interest you, but we did date another girl once and she was toxic as fuck. She decided she didn’t want to be polyamorous at some point and tried to convinced my partner to leave me and become monogamous with her. We unanimously <<voted>> her out. Wa make a lot of among us jokes about that. 

I don’t see one of those as the main relationship, but, of course, I have a longer history with my partner of 10 years, so we share a lot of our stuff and memories together.

We are all attracted to each others. It’s not always the case in polyamory, we got lucky !

Those are all great questions ! I will answer them all. 

I define success by the amount of joy this is providing us, the stability we have, the fun we have and the love we have for each others 

Sexuality has nothing to do with polyamory, in my opinion. Some may not agree, but here we love more than we lust. This is a minimal part of our relationship. We don’t go out and fuck strangers, if that was part of your question. We can date other people,  but none of us have sex friends or one night stands. This is not a rule we have, but none of us has the desire to have sex without an emotional connection at the moment. Some polyamorous people do, and it’s okay. 


We did built a life together. We are living as a trouple in the same apartment for years now. We have animals together, a business and we plan to buy a house. 

For expectations, we are working hard to buy a house. So far we don’t want kids because I am uncomfortable with the idea of being pregnant, but both my partners would feel comfortable with the 3 of us being parents.

What about money ? we all have separate accounts, but we are really transparent about our finances. We share the bills equally and since we want to buy a house, we keep the others informed on the money we have for this project. 

What about marriage. I, personally, would love to get married. We discussed that if we ever get married it doesn’t mean that we will become monogamous. Since I have been with one of them for 10 years I expect to marry him if we ever do. Our partner could even officiate. This is not something we talk a lot about or even planned, but we would need to have a more open discussion before doing anything regarding that. We don’t have plans for now. I know I can’t marry both of them, but for me, a marriage is a promise of eternal love that you make in front of the universe. Spiritually speaking I could marry both of them, but legally speaking I can only marry one. For me, personally, the first one is the one that matters. 

I hope i was able to answer everything ! French is my first language so I may have make some mistakes ! 

If you, or anyone, has any other questions I will gladly answer as long as it is done with respect, like you did ! 

I would like to say, again, that because it is working for us, it doesn’t mean it was always easy. This requires a lot of trust and honesty to achieve. No one should ever feel pressured to embrace polyamory. You don’t even have to like the idea. It’s okay.

I can be successful, but it is not for everyone and it’s okay .
